general.title: About Server Eggs
general.desc:
**Server Eggs** is a Discord bot created by **HexaBlue**.
It is designed as a fun way to share content, from which someone may want to join its origin server.
general.about_desc:
An **Egg** is some text, an attachment (through file or URL), or both.
When an **Egg** is created, it is accessible from any server with **Server Eggs**.
general.how_desc:
- To **create an Egg**, use `/create` in a server.
- To **receive** an Egg, use `/get`.
general.donate_desc: You can **support the development** of **Server Eggs** by donating to **[HexaBlue's Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/hexablue)**

create.title: About Creating Eggs
create.desc:
**Commands**: `/create`, `/lay`

Using these commands, you may **create an Egg**. The **Egg** you create will then be available **anywhere that Server Eggs is**.

**Parameters**:
- `text`: [Optional] Add **text** to the **Egg**.
  - It will appear as the description of the Embed.
- `file`: [Optional] Add an **attachment** to the **Egg**, as a file.
- `link`: [Optional] Add an **attachment** to the **Egg**, as a URL.
  - Useful if you want to use GIF providers such as Klipy.
  - ***Note**: You may not use both `file` and `link` at the same time.*
- `secret`: [Optional] Mark an **Egg** as **Secret**!
  - This means that it **won't be possible** to view this **Egg** by ID: only randomly!
- `rating`: [Optional] The **content rating** of the **Egg**.
  - `Safe`, `Questionable`, or `Explicit`.
    - **More explicit ratings** are only allowed in **NSFW channels**. It depends on the server's settings.

get.title: About Obtaining Eggs
get.desc:
**Commands**: `/get`, `/egg`

Using these commands, you will **receive an Egg**. If the `id` parameter isn't specified, the **Egg** will be **picked randomly from the global pool** and **added to your collection** if you haven't seen it before.

**Parameters**:
- `id`: [Optional] View a specific **Egg** by searching for its ID.

edit.title: About Editing Eggs
edit.desc:
**Commands**: `/edit`

Using this command, you may **edit an Egg**. You must have permission to manage it: so you must either **be its creator** or **be a Server Manager where it was created**.
You **only override the parameters you select here**, meaning that, if you made a text-only **Egg** and wanted to make it Secret, you would only need to set `secret` to `True` here, without touching `text`.

**Parameters**:
- `id`: The ID of the **Egg** you want to edit.
- Other parameters are the same as `/create`/`/lay`.

report.title: About Reporting Eggs
report.desc:
**Commands**: `/report`

Using this command, or through the "Report" button when receiving an **Egg**, you can **report an Egg**. This will send it to the global **Egg Moderators**, who will decide what action to take. If you suspect that an **Egg** may be violating a rule, don't hesistate to report it!

**Parameters**:
- `id`: The ID of the **Egg** you want to report.

delete.title: About Deleting Eggs
delete.desc:
**Commands**: `/delete`

Using this command, you may **delete an Egg**. You must have permission to manage it: so you must either **be its creator** or **be a Server Manager where it was created**.

**Parameters**:
- `id`: The ID of the **Egg** you want to delete.

eggify.title: About Eggifying Messages
eggify.desc:
You may **turn a message into an Egg** by right-clicking it (or holding it, on mobile), going to the *Apps* menu, and choosing ***Eggify***.
From there, you can **modify the text** (by default, it'll be the *original message's content*), set its **Secret** status, and choose its **rating**.

collected.title: About Egg Collections
collected.desc:
**Commands**: `/collected`

Using this command, you can **view your Egg collection**, which is comprised of all the **Egg**s you found randomly. Alternatively, you may also use the `check` parameter to see if you have collected a specific **Egg**.

**Parameters**:
- `check`: [Optional] The ID of an **Egg**, to see if you've collected it.
- `rating`: [Optional] Filters your collection by a specific **rating**.
- `only-secret`: [Optional] Filters your collection, and shows you only the **Secret Egg**s you've found.

leaderboard.title: About Leaderboards
leaderboard.desc:
**Commands**: `/leaderboard collections`, `/leaderboard creations`, `/leaderboard battles`, `/leaderboard battlers`

The leaderboard commands allow you to view the **Top 15** of a certain category.
These categories are:
- **Collections**: Users who have collected the most **Egg**s.
- **Creations**: Users who have created the most **Egg**s.
- **Battles**: **Egg**s that have won the most battles.
- **Battlers**: Users who have won the most battles.

config.title: About Configuring Server Eggs
config.desc:
**Commands**: `/config lang`, `/config allow-user-lang`, `/config privacy`, `/config log`, `/config allowed-ratings`, `/config join-button`

The configuration commands allow Server Managers to set up **Server Eggs** the way they see fit.

- `/config lang`: Sets the bot's **response language** in this server (or for a user, if ran in DMs).
  - `lang` parameter: The language to set.
- `/config allow-user-lang`: Permit usage of **user-specified languages** in this server.
  - `allow` parameter: True or False.
- `/config privacy`: Change the **privacy setting** for this server (or for a user, if ran in DMs).
  - `public` parameter: True or False.
    - **In servers**: Allow **anyone** to **join this server** through **Egg**s created in it.
    - **In DMs**: Allow anyone who **views one of your Eggs** to see your **username** and **profile**.
- `/config log`: Set a **log channel** for **Egg creations and edits** that happen in this server.
  - `channel` parameter: The log channel to use.
- `/config allowed-ratings normal`: Change which **ratings** are allowed in **SFW channels**.
  - `safe`, `questionable`, `explicit` parameters: Whether each rating is allowed. Omitted ones keep their current value.
- `/config allowed-ratings nsfw`: Change which **ratings** are allowed in **NSFW channels**.
  - `safe`, `questionable`, `explicit` parameters: Whether each rating is allowed. Omitted ones keep their current value.
- `/config join-button`: Change whether the **"Join Origin Server"** button appears on **Egg**s gotten here.
  - `viewable` parameter: True or False.
- `/config battle-time`: Change how **long battles** last before they expire.
  - `minutes` parameter: How many minutes a battle should last.
- `/config channel-rating`: Set the **default rating** for **Egg**s created in a channel.
  - `channel` parameter: The channel to set the rating for.
  - `rating` parameter: The new default rating for that channel.

filter.title: About Filtering Eggs
filter.desc:
**Commands**: `/filter`

Using this command, Server Managers can **toggle filtering** for an **Egg**. This is helpful when an **Egg** does not break the *global* rules, and therefore is allowed by the **Egg Moderators**, but *local* server moderators feel it's inappropriate for their members.
If an **Egg** was **already filtered**, running this command on it again will **unfilter it**.

**Parameters**:
- `id`: The ID of the **Egg** you want to toggle filters for.
